lead_raw_text:
The structure of Co2O3 (Co4O6 per cell) is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Co centers as octahedral, each coordinated by six O neighbors (about 2.10–2.13 Å), while O centers have four geometric neighbors (two Co, two O). The Co-centered octahedra display corner- and edge-sharing contacts, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
